---
title: "Speaker notes"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      # speaker notes ride through as emil.js's hidden aside (SPEC A42)
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['aside.emiljs-notes[hidden]', '#s2 aside.emiljs-notes']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['aside.emiljs-notes']
          matches: ['Say this first']
        - selectors: ['#s2 aside.emiljs-notes']
          matches: ['Braces form']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['::: \{\.notes\}', 'Say this \*\*first\*\*']
---

## First

Visible body.

::: notes
Say this **first**.

- Mention the benchmark
:::

---

## Second

More.

::: {.notes}
Braces form.
:::
